name: Anakin.io
description: Anakin.io is a web data API to scrape, crawl, map and search any website, run pre-built Wire actions on 940+ sites, and monitor pages for changes.

events.d: Scrape a web page and get its Markdown, HTML, links, summary or AI-extracted JSON.
Scrape up to 10 web pages in one batch job.
Get the status and content of a single or batch scrape job by its job ID.
Run an AI-powered web search and get ranked results with snippets.
Start a multi-stage AI research job that searches, scrapes sources and writes a report.
Get the status and report of an agentic research job by its job ID.
Start a website crawl to discover and scrape pages; configure URL, max pages, depth, include/exclude patterns, country, browser, session ID, and webhook.
Get the status and scraped pages of a crawl job by its job ID.
Discover a site's URLs via sitemap and links; configure depth, limits, subdomains, external links, and webhook.
Get the status and discovered URLs of a map job by its job ID.
Run a pre-built Wire action on a supported site, such as search products or fetch a profile.
Get the status and data of a Wire action run by its job ID.
Create a monitor that checks a page, a whole site or a Wire action on a schedule and records changes.
List all website monitors or fetch one monitor by its ID.
